collections.title: Men's Jorts & Baggy Shorts
collections.description:
Our men's jorts and baggy shorts are as bold as they are comfortable, ranging from baggy jorts for men to versatile men's loose fit shorts. Tap into Y2K-inspired silhouettes with long-line cuts or keep it laid-back with carpenter and utility details. Team a pair of light wash jumbo denim jorts with a camo long sleeve men's top and boots for a street-ready, edgy look. Or switch it up with a pair of baggy cargo parachute shorts, perfect for dressing up or down. Whether you're styling for a festival, a day out, or a chilled day at home, our men's jorts and baggy shorts elevate every outfit. Just add a men's hoodie or men's jacket to finish the look.

How to Style Men's Jorts?

Pair your men's jorts with a fitted tee or vest, or go full oversized for that relaxed, off-duty look. Style the Goliath jorts with a simple white tee for an easy, everyday fit, or go pinstripe with loafers for something sharper. Trainers keep it street, chunky boots bring the edge.

What to Wear With Men's Jorts?

Jorts work best when you lean into easy, simple pieces as they are a statement. Try them with a men's baggy t-shirt for a relaxed, classic look. For footwear, pair with chunky trainers for a more streetwear feel. You can also throw on an oversized lightweight men's hoodie for an off-duty look that still looks pulled together.

What Shoes go with Jorts for Men?

Style your jorts for men with trainers for everyday wear, or dial it up with chunky boots for something with more presence. For an edgier, streetwear-inspired finish, try Jaded London's signature tower boots or a stacked-sole boot.

Keep it simple or go full double denim - pair your denim jacket with a plain white tee and women's black bootcut jeans for an easy everyday look, or clash blue wash on blue wash if you're feeling bold. Is Double Denim in Fashion?
Double denim is a wardrobe staple that keeps coming back into fashion - and the modern way to wear it is less about matching sets, more about clashing washes and textures. Pair a fitted denim piece with something oversized, keep your denim tones a shade or two apart, and mix in leather or knit to break it up.

Dressing up denim is all about contrast. Throw on a fitted top, corset or embellished backless top to level up the look instantly. Women's jorts are oversized, baggy denim shorts, often longer and looser with a cut that hits at or just below the knee. Heavily inspired by Y2K, the style spans distressed 90s skater fits to tailored Bermuda shapes, giving a denim alternative to traditional women's shorts.

Women's jorts are built for statement fits. Go baggy with the Colossus Jorts in camo or bleached indigo for that oversized, Y2K-style, or keep it lighter with the Light Wash Jumbo Jorts for an easy everyday feel.
